content: I was so excited to finally upgrade to a foam mattress, lured in by the promise of cloud-like comfort and pressure relief. What I received was a dense, unyielding slab of synthetic material that felt more like sleeping on a gym mat. The "cooling" technology is a flat-out lie, as I consistently woke up sweating and overheated. Every movement created a sinkhole effect, trapping me and making it incredibly difficult to change positions. The edges offered absolutely no support, causing a perpetual feeling of rolling off the bed. My back pain has actually worsened since switching to this mattress, which defeats the entire purpose. Save your money and your spine; this is not the dreamy sleep experience it claims to be. Returning this monstrosity immediately.
